title: 人工智能，从零搭建 · 第18部分：智能体与世界

chapters.Outro: 回顾，以及这些想法会在哪里再现

a93b3bdf846b.en: A chatbot answers one question. <bookmark mark='j'/> An agent has to do a whole job: thirty steps, a hundred, a thousand, each depending on the last. <bookmark mark='a'/> Even at ninety-seven percent per step, thirty steps in a row succeed only 40 percent of the time.
a93b3bdf846b.zh: 聊天机器人，回答一个问题就够了。<bookmark mark='j'/>智能体却要完成一整项工作：30步、100步、1000步，每一步都取决于上一步。<bookmark mark='a'/>就算每一步都有97%的把握，连着走30步，也只有40%的时候能全部做对。

b83817c7897d.en: Here are 60 attempts at once. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each step, a few more runs go wrong, and a run that has gone wrong stays wrong. <bookmark mark='b'/> By step thirty, 27 of 60 are still on track.
b83817c7897d.zh: 这里是同时进行的60次尝试。<bookmark mark='a'/>每走一步，就又有几次出了错；而一次尝试一旦出错，就会一直错下去。<bookmark mark='b'/>到了第30步，60次里还有27次走在正轨上。

d6697af147db.en: This part is about agents: acting on a belief, surviving long chains of steps, imagining the future, <bookmark mark='a'/> and moving in the physical world.
d6697af147db.zh: 这一部分讲的是智能体：依据信念行动，挺过漫长的步骤链，想象未来，<bookmark mark='a'/>以及在物理世界里动起来。

58b8d5087b18.en: Chapter one. Acting without seeing everything.

0d6d6ef660aa.en: An agent acts in a world it can only partly see. Here's the classic example: a robot in a corridor with a few doors, which doesn't know where it is. Its knowledge is a belief: a probability for every cell, spread evenly at first. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each step it moves right, sometimes slipping, so the belief shifts and blurs. Then it senses: door, or no door, and Bayes' rule from part four multiplies the belief by how well each cell explains what it saw. <bookmark mark='b'/> Watch the uncertainty fall as the pattern of doors gives the place away. This is part six's hidden Markov model, run forward: an agent in a partly observed world, a POMDP, acts on its belief, not on the truth.
0d6d6ef660aa.zh: 智能体所在的世界，它只能看到一部分。这里有一个经典的例子：一条走廊，有几扇门，走廊里有一个机器人，它不知道自己在哪里。它所知道的，是一份信念：每个格子一个概率，一开始平均分布。<bookmark mark='a'/>每一步，它都往右走一格，有时会打滑，于是信念跟着往右挪，也变得更模糊。然后它感知一下：有门，还是没有门；第4部分的贝叶斯法则，把每个格子的信念，乘以这个格子能多好地解释它看到的东西。<bookmark mark='b'/>看，门的排列方式渐渐暴露出它的位置，不确定性也随之下降。这就是第6部分的隐马尔可夫模型，向前运行：在一个只能部分观测的世界里，也就是POMDP里，智能体依据的是自己的信念，而不是真相。

ed79b55f8459.en: Agents work in long chains of steps: read a page, click, write code, run it, read the error. Every step has to go right. <bookmark mark='a'/> If each step succeeds with probability p, a task of n steps succeeds with p to the n. <bookmark mark='b'/> At ninety percent per step, a ten-step task already fails two times in three. At ninety-nine percent, a hundred-step task succeeds only 37 percent of the time. Small errors compound.
ed79b55f8459.zh: 智能体干活，靠的是一长串步骤：读一个网页，点一下，写代码，运行，再读报错信息。每一步都必须做对。<bookmark mark='a'/>如果每一步成功的概率是p，那么n步的任务，成功的概率就是p的n次方。<bookmark mark='b'/>每一步有90%的把握，10步的任务，就已经是三次里有两次失败。每一步有99%的把握，100步的任务，也只有37%的时候能完成。小错误会层层累积。

3af607d81344.en: Turn it around: how long a task can an agent finish half the time? <bookmark mark='a'/> It's about zero point seven divided by the error rate per step. Halve the errors, and the reachable task length doubles. <bookmark mark='b'/> METR measured exactly this for real AI agents, on tasks timed by how long they take people: the length agents finish half the time has doubled about every seven months, for six years. Reliability per step is what buys long horizons.
3af607d81344.zh: 反过来问：一个智能体有一半把握完成的任务，最长能有多长？<bookmark mark='a'/>大约是0.7，除以每一步的出错率。错误减半，能完成的任务长度就翻一倍。<bookmark mark='b'/>METR正是在真实的AI智能体上测量了这一点，任务的长短，按人完成它要花多少时间来算：智能体有一半把握完成的任务长度，大约每7个月翻一番，已经持续了6年。能换来长时程的，正是每一步的可靠性。

b3cdd81d82c6.en: To plan, an agent needs to predict what its actions will do. A world model learns that from experience. <bookmark mark='a'/> Ours watches a ball bouncing in a box. It squeezes each frame into eight numbers, learns how those numbers change from one frame to the next, and can turn numbers back into a picture.
b3cdd81d82c6.zh: 要做计划，智能体就得预测自己的行动会带来什么。世界模型，就是从经验中学会这一点。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们的世界模型，看的是一个在盒子里弹来弹去的球。它把每一帧压缩成8个数，学会这些数从一帧到下一帧怎样变化，还能把这些数重新变回一幅画面。

a5f021398e2f.en: Now let it imagine. Give it two real frames and let it run on its own predictions, step after step, <bookmark mark='a'/> while the real ball keeps going. For a while, imagination and reality move together: one step ahead it's 0.1 pixels off. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then small errors compound, like the long tasks of the last chapter: 5.3 pixels off after twenty steps. <bookmark mark='c'/> Agents like Dreamer learn by practising inside such imagined worlds, and Genie generates whole playable worlds from video.
a5f021398e2f.zh: 现在，让它来想象。给它两帧真实的画面，然后让它靠自己的预测往下走，一步接一步，<bookmark mark='a'/>而真实的球也在继续运动。有一阵子，想象和现实同步前进：往前看一步，只差0.1个像素。<bookmark mark='b'/>然后，小误差开始累积，就像上一章的长任务一样：想象20步之后，差了5.3个像素。<bookmark mark='c'/>像Dreamer这样的智能体，就是在这种想象出来的世界里反复练习、学会本领的；而Genie，从视频中学会了生成一个个完整的、可以玩的世界。

fb95bf572eed.en: Chapter four. Acting in the physical world.
fb95bf572eed.zh: 第4章。在物理世界中行动。

05fda875de91.en: Robots are where agents meet physics. A vision-language-action model starts from a model that already reads images and text, trained on the web. <bookmark mark='a'/> Give it camera images and an instruction, and add a way to output motion. <bookmark mark='r'/> RT-2, in 2023, wrote actions as tokens, like words. <bookmark mark='b'/> Pi-zero, in 2024, added an action expert that generates smooth motions by flow matching, part fourteen's machinery, now drawing trajectories instead of pictures.
05fda875de91.zh: 机器人，是智能体和物理世界相遇的地方。视觉–语言–动作模型的起点，是一个已经能读懂图像和文字的模型，它是在网络数据上训练出来的。<bookmark mark='a'/>给它摄像头拍到的画面和一条指令，再给它加上一种输出动作的办法。<bookmark mark='r'/>2023年的RT-2，把动作写成词元，就像写词一样。<bookmark mark='b'/>2024年的π0，加上了一个动作专家，用流匹配来生成平滑的动作；这正是第14部分的那套机制，只不过现在画出来的不是图像，而是运动轨迹。

4fe1507d7c70.en: And it doesn't act one tiny step at a time. It plans a chunk of motion, a second or so, then looks at the world again and plans the next: <bookmark mark='a'/> the belief and the world model of the earlier chapters, folded into one network that sees, thinks and moves.
4fe1507d7c70.zh: 而且，它并不是一小步一小步地行动。它一次规划一段动作，大约1秒，然后再看一眼世界，规划下一段：<bookmark mark='a'/>前面几章的信念和世界模型，都合进了同一个网络，它能看、能想、能动。

649678677dd2.en: Let's take stock. An agent acts on a belief, updated by Bayes' rule as it moves and senses. Over long tasks, small errors compound, so reliability per step sets how far it can go, and that reach has been doubling every seven months. A world model lets it imagine before it acts, until its own errors catch up with it. And robots now run on models that see, read and move.
649678677dd2.zh: 我们来盘点一下。智能体依据信念行动，这份信念在它移动和感知的过程中，用贝叶斯法则不断更新。在长任务里，小错误会层层累积，所以每一步的可靠性，决定了它能走多远；而这个距离，一直在每7个月翻一番。世界模型让它在行动之前先想象，直到它自己的误差追上来。而如今的机器人，靠的是能看、能读、能动的模型。

a0638fefdc58.en: Agents run models many times per task, so the next part, on inference, is about making each run fast. And the last part looks inside the model, to see what it actually knows.
a0638fefdc58.zh: 智能体完成一项任务，要把模型运行很多次，所以下一部分的主题是推断：怎样让每一次运行都快起来。而最后一部分，要看进模型内部，看看它到底知道些什么。

6a6052455904.en: Next time: inference. How a small model can guess ahead and a big one check its guesses all at once, <bookmark mark='a'/> with exactly the same output; and how to store numbers in four bits.
6a6052455904.zh: 下一次：推断。一个小模型怎样先往前猜，再让大模型一次性核对它所有的猜测，<bookmark mark='a'/>而输出和大模型自己写出来的完全一样；以及怎样用4个比特来存一个数。

fb98d0696e50.en: Thanks for watching, and see you in part nineteen.
